policy_ingestion.defaults: No rule match -> confirmation dialog (DOC). Unknowns serialize as unknown with layer attribution, never as allow.
policy_ingestion.surface: ~/.gemini/policies/*.toml (user), adminPolicyPaths (admin), --policy/--admin-policy flags. [[rule]]: toolName, commandPrefix (string|array), commandRegex, argsPattern, decision = allow|deny|ask_user, priority, modes, interactive. Tiers: Admin > User > Default REGARDLESS of priority number. confirmationRequired takes precedence over allowed + core. tools.sandbox OFF by default.
